entry.title: Bluetooth Auto Toggle 1.1.0
entry.content:
Bluetooth Auto Toggle

A Windhawk tool mod that automatically cycles Windows Bluetooth off and back on (in milliseconds) whenever Windhawk boots with your system and a connected Bluetooth device is detected.

Why this mod?

Some Bluetooth hardware adapters, drivers, and wireless peripherals (e.g., Bluetooth headphones, earbuds, mice, and keyboards) enter an unresponsive or degraded state on fresh system boots—even when Windows displays them as "connected"—causing audio silence, latency, or connection drops unless Bluetooth is power-cycled. This mod automates that process by waiting until a device is connected, pausing a configurable few seconds for the driver stack to settle, and cleanly cycling the Bluetooth radio off and then back on in the background.

Key Features

  • Device-Aware Activation: By default, only cycles Bluetooth when a connected Bluetooth device (headset, mouse, keyboard, etc.) is found.
  • Precise Millisecond Timing: Configurable startup delay, post-connection delay, and off-to-on toggle duration in milliseconds.
  • Dedicated Tool Mod Architecture: Runs in an isolated windhawk.exe background tool process without injecting into or hooking explorer.exe or any other critical system process.
  • Cold Boot Hardware Retry: Automatically retries radio enumeration if the Bluetooth service (bthserv) or adapter driver is still initializing during Windows boot.
  • State-Safe Cycling: Only toggles radios that are already powered ON (leaving radios in Airplane mode or turned off alone).
  • Safe Power Restoration: Minimizes the off window and ensures radios are commanded back on with retries even if the mod is unloaded mid-cycle.
  • Session-Safe: Remembers the current Windows logon session across tool process restarts using Windows Terminal Services (WTS) logon timestamps.
  • Graceful Lifecycle & Live Testing: Responsive to settings updates, mod reload, and instant cancellation on shutdown.

entry.title: Force Desktop Icon Spacing 1.1.6
entry.content:
Precisely control the desktop icon spacing: set the horizontal/vertical icon grid spacing and reserve a blank margin at the bottom of the icon area (above the taskbar).

How it works

  • The desktop list view (SysListView32) is subclassed (event-driven; the only polling is a one-time boot check that polls the icon count once a second for up to a minute after Explorer starts): every spacing request Explorer makes is transparently replaced with the configured values, and the icon area height is capped so it never enters the reserved bottom strip.
  • Values are absolute and applied in one pass: the same settings always produce the same layout, never cumulative drift.
  • The vertical grid is anchored at the top: increasing the vertical spacing stretches the grid downward, so the extra space is absorbed by the bottom region. No blank strip is created at the top, and the icon area is never shifted as a whole.
  • The bottom margin caps the icon area height only (the top edge stays fixed), so icon columns wrap earlier and never enter the reserved bottom strip.
  • All pixel values are scaled by the list view's DPI: the configured numbers apply at 100% scaling and scale up automatically on higher DPI.

Settings

  • Horizontal spacing (pixels): width of each icon grid cell, at 100% scaling. Larger = more horizontal gap between icons.
  • Vertical spacing (pixels): height of each icon grid cell, at 100% scaling. Larger = taller rows; the grid grows downward and the extra space is absorbed by the bottom region.
  • Bottom margin (pixels): blank strip reserved at the bottom of the icon area, above the taskbar, at 100% scaling. The icon grid never enters it. 0 = no reservation.
  • Rearrange icons on startup: arrange icons once when the mod loads and every time Explorer starts (sign-in, reboot, Explorer restart), so the spacing/margin take effect. Turn this off to keep icons where you place them by hand. Changes made in the settings always rearrange.

Notes

  • The grid cell size stays fixed when you change the icon size (Large/Medium/Small icons or Ctrl+wheel); adjust the spacing settings when you switch to Large icons, otherwise large icons may overlap their labels.
  • This mod doesn't write any registry values. If you want free icon placement, turn off "Auto arrange icons" and "Align icons to grid" in the desktop right-click menu yourself.
  • Disabling or unloading the mod restores the original icon spacing and the full icon area height. Icons stay where the mod arranged them (as with a manual "Arrange icons").
  • The bottom margin applies to the whole icon area (the list view spans all monitors); on multi-monitor setups it lands above the taskbar of the bottom-most monitor.

简体中文说明

精确控制桌面图标间距：自由调节图标网格的水平/垂直间距，并在图标区域底部（任务栏上方）预留空白边距。

工作原理

  • 通过子类化（事件驱动；唯一的轮询是资源管理器启动后长达一分钟、每秒一次的图标数量一次性开机检查）挂钩桌面列表视图（SysListView32）：资源管理器发出的每个间距设置请求都会被透明替换为配置值，图标区域高度被限制在预留边距之上。
  • 所有数值均为绝对值、一次性应用——同一配置永远得到同一布局，不存在多次叠加漂移。
  • 垂直网格顶端锚定：调大垂直间距时行距拉大、网格向下延伸，多余空间挤占底部区域——顶部不会产生空白，图标区域也不会被整体移动。
  • 底部边距只限制图标区域高度（顶边固定），图标换列提前，永不进入底部预留区。
  • 所有像素值按列表视图的 DPI 自动缩放：配置数值对应 100% 缩放，高 DPI 下自动放大。

设置项

  • 水平间距（像素）：图标网格单元宽度（100% 缩放下），数值越大图标水平间距越大。
  • 垂直间距（像素）：图标网格单元高度（100% 缩放下），数值越大行距越大，网格向下延伸，多余空间挤占底部区域。
  • 底部边距（像素）：图标区域底部（任务栏上方）预留的空白高度（100% 缩放下），图标网格不会进入该区域。0 = 不预留。
  • 启动时重排图标：模组加载时以及资源管理器每次启动时（登录、重启、重启资源管理器）各执行一次"排列图标"，使间距/边距生效。若希望保留手动拖放的图标布局，可关闭此项。在设置面板修改参数时始终会重排。

注意

  • 切换图标大小（大/中/小图标或 Ctrl+滚轮）时网格单元尺寸保持不变；切换到大图标时请相应调大间距设置，否则大图标可能与文字标签重叠。
  • 本模组不写入任何注册表值。如需自由摆放图标，请自行在桌面右键菜单中关闭"自动排列图标"和"将图标与网格对齐"。
  • 停用或卸载模组会自动恢复原始图标间距与图标区域完整高度；图标停留在重排后的位置（与手动"排列图标"一致）。
  • 底部边距作用于整个图标区域（列表视图横跨所有显示器）；多显示器下预留空白位于最底部显示器的任务栏上方。

entry.title: Language Switcher Position 1.3
entry.content:
Language Switcher Position

English

This mod allows you to customize the position of the modern Windows 11 26H2 input language switcher, which appears when clicking the language indicator (РУС / ENG) in the system tray.

Features

  • Left — positions the switcher at the left edge of the screen.
  • Center — positions the switcher in the center of the screen.
  • Right — positions the switcher at the right edge of the screen.
  • Custom X/Y — manually sets the window coordinates.
  • Vertical offset — provides additional vertical positioning control.

Screenshots

Settings

Horizontal position — selects the horizontal alignment: Left, Center, Right, or Custom X/Y.

Custom X coordinate — the horizontal window coordinate in pixels.

Custom Y coordinate — the vertical window coordinate in pixels.

Vertical offset — additional vertical displacement relative to the original Windows position. Used with Left, Center, and Right modes.

Compatibility

  • Windows 11 26H2
  • Windows Explorer (explorer.exe)
  • Modern XAML input language switcher.

Note

Positioning is calculated relative to the full monitor dimensions, including the taskbar area. Custom coordinates are specified in screen pixels.

The mod only changes the position of the switcher window and does not modify Windows input language settings.

Українська

Мод дозволяє змінювати положення сучасного перемикача мов введення Windows 11 26H2, який з'являється після натискання на індикатор мови (РУС / ENG) у системному треї.

Можливості

  • Left — розміщення перемикача біля лівого краю екрана.
  • Center — розміщення по центру екрана.
  • Right — розміщення біля правого краю екрана.
  • Custom X/Y — ручне налаштування координат вікна.
  • Vertical offset — додаткове вертикальне зміщення.

Налаштування

Horizontal position — вибір горизонтального розташування перемикача: Left, Center, Right або Custom X/Y.

Custom X coordinate — горизонтальна координата вікна в пікселях.

Custom Y coordinate — вертикальна координата вікна в пікселях.

Vertical offset — додаткове вертикальне зміщення відносно початкової позиції Windows. Використовується в режимах Left, Center та Right.

Сумісність

  • Windows 11 26H2
  • Windows Explorer (explorer.exe)
  • Сучасний XAML-перемикач мов введення.

Примітка

Позиціонування виконується відносно повного розміру монітора, включно з областю панелі завдань. Користувацькі координати задаються в екранних пікселях.

Мод змінює лише положення вікна перемикача та не впливає на системні налаштування мов введення.

entry.title: Siri Plus Launchpad 1.0.0
entry.content:
Siri Plus Launchpad

A Windhawk mod that replaces the Windows 11 Start menu with a macOS-inspired launcher: a Siri-style search bar with a categories menu, app tabs, file search, clipboard history, quick actions and live glass effects.

Press the Windows key (or click Start) and type, or pick what you want to search from the menu that drops down from the bar.

Highlights

  • Four modes: Original Siri (default), Floating, Window and Fullscreen
  • Live glass: real-time blur behind the bar and panels (animated wallpapers and videos keep playing underneath), plus an experimental liquid glass with refraction in the Siri modes
  • One search for everything: Apps, Files, Clipboard and Actions
  • App tabs: All, automatic categories and up to 6 tabs of your own
  • Recent apps row: recently opened or installed apps (or the most used ones) on top
  • Power options: type shut down, restart, sleep, lock or sign out, or use the floating power button
  • Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+1 … Ctrl+4 jump to Applications, Files, Actions and Clipboard, and can also open the launcher from any program (optional)
  • Custom icons: give any app your own icon (PNG, JPG, ICO, WebP…), or pick one from an icon gallery (any folder of icons, such as a downloaded icon pack), with search and a color filter
  • Themes: Clear glass, Light, Dark, OLED (deep black), Siri (macOS 27 gradient) and a fully Custom theme, with an optional glass effect on Light, Dark and OLED
  • Settings panel: the ⋯ button at the end of the bar opens every setting in a macOS-style panel, applied live
  • Move the bar: hold the Siri bar and drag it anywhere, on any monitor
  • Backup: save settings, folders, tabs and custom icons to one file and restore them, even after reinstalling
  • Your language: follows the Windows display language, or pick one (English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German and Italian)

Screenshots

Original Siri (default)

| Clear glass | Dark | OLED | |---|---|---| | | | |

Floating

| Clear glass | Light | Siri gradient | |---|---|---| | | | |

| Dark | OLED | |---|---| | | |

Window

| Clear glass | Light | Siri gradient | |---|---|---| | | | |

| Dark | OLED | |---|---| | | |

Fullscreen

| Clear glass | Light | Siri gradient | |---|---|---| | | | |

| Dark | OLED | |---|---| | | |

In action

| Settings panel | Moving the bar | |---|---| | | |

| Right-click menus and tabs | Power options | |---|---| | | |

Modes

Original Siri (default)

A search bar in the macOS 27 style.

  • Categories menu: hover over the bar (or click it) and a menu drops down with Applications, Files, Actions and Clipboard, each with its icon and its keyboard shortcut (default Ctrl+1 … Ctrl+4, configurable).
  • Picking a category makes its icon and name glide from the menu into the bar, and the search then works inside that category. If you type straight away, you go to Applications.
  • Going back: hover the category icon in the bar and it turns into a back arrow. Click it, or press Esc, to return to "Search" with the magnifier and pick another category.
  • App tabs:
  • All comes first and shows every app.
  • Then the automatic categories: Utilities, Productivity, Entertainment, Social, Creativity, Reading and Other.
  • Then up to 6 tabs of your own, for example "Games".
  • First row: recently opened or installed apps, or the most used ones (configurable), separated from the rest by a thin line.
  • Actions: Lock, Sleep, Restart, Shut down, Sign out, Settings, Task Manager, File Explorer, Control Panel, Screenshot and Empty Recycle Bin. Shut down works like Windows' own (fast startup when it is on) and warns before signing off other users who are still signed in.

Floating

The bar appears out of an animated circle, the Siri wave or a soft glow, with zoom and an adjustable bounce. Clicking it or typing slides the results panel down. When it closes, the bar is "sucked" back into the bubble.

Window and Fullscreen

The classic Launchpad grid with pages or vertical scrolling, folders and a power button. Pages always slide inside the glass. Fullscreen respects the work area and the space reserved by docks.

Managing app tabs (Original Siri)

| What | How | |---|---| | Create a tab | Right-click an app → New tab with this app, or right-click the tab strip / an empty area → New tab. Type the name and press Enter | | Add apps | Inside a tab, right-click → Add app. A picker shows every app: long-press the first one, then a simple click selects or deselects the others (selected apps jiggle); Done saves | | Remove an app | Inside a tab, right-click the app → Remove from tab | | Rename or delete | Right-click the tab → Rename tab / Delete tab | | Built-in tabs | They can also be edited (add or remove apps) and deleted. Restore default tabs brings them back | | Move through tabs | Tab / Shift+Tab, or click and drag the strip sideways (the mouse wheel works too) |

Files

  • Indexer: Everything (through IPC, no DLL needed), Windows Search or a direct scan. The default, Automatic, uses the first one that is available.
  • When the search is empty, your recent searches are shown, with a button to clear them. History can be turned off.
  • Results show the folder of each file under its name, in a list or as icons.
  • The maximum number of results is configurable.

Clipboard

  • Keeps the texts you copy while the mod runs (in memory only, never saved). The number of items and how long a copy stays (15 minutes to 7 days, or until Windows restarts) are configurable.
  • The category only shows up when there is something in it. Each item has an × to remove it, and right-clicking gives Clear clipboard, which empties the history and the Windows clipboard.
  • Passwords stay out: items that password managers and browsers mark as secret are skipped, just like Windows' own clipboard history (Win+V).
  • Shown as a list: the first line of each text, with a preview of the rest (or its size) underneath.
  • Click an item to copy it again. Turning the category off also stops monitoring and clears the history.

Apps and icons

  • Search apps by typing.
  • Folders (Window and Fullscreen): drag apps together, rename, undo. The Siri modes list the apps of every folder together.
  • Multi-select with jiggling icons, pin to taskbar (also by dragging an icon to the taskbar), uninstall.
  • Custom icons: right-click an app → Change icon… and pick an image (PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, ICO, GIF or WebP). The new icon is remembered across restarts; Reset icon brings back the original. Works in every mode, including apps inside folders.
  • Icon gallery: choose a folder of icon images in the settings (Apps and icons → Icon gallery folder, typed or picked with Choose…), for example a downloaded icon pack. Then right-click an app → Icon from gallery… The folder's images (subfolders included) show in the grid; type to search them by name, or use the color dots to see only one color or put them in rainbow order. Images added to the folder show up the next time the gallery opens. After picking, the launcher goes back to where it was, with that app selected.
  • Icon size, number of columns and the scrolling direction are configurable.

Settings panel

  • Click the ⋯ button at the end of the bar (every mode). The bar moves to the left and becomes a list of sections, and a panel with the settings comes out of the button. Every change applies at once.
  • Changes made there are kept on top of Windhawk's settings, and a change made later in Windhawk wins again.
  • Theme defaults (Appearance) brings back the chosen theme's own look. Restore all defaults (General) puts every setting back to how the mod comes and the bar back in the center; folders, tabs and custom icons stay.
  • Back up saves everything to a .siribackup file: every setting (the icon gallery folder too), folders, tabs, search history, the bar's place and the custom icons, with their pictures inside the file. Restore a backup brings it all back, also after uninstalling the mod (which erases its stored data) or on another PC.
  • In Window and Fullscreen the window folds into its search field while the settings are open. With the bar low on the screen, the settings open upward.

Moving the bar (Floating and Original Siri)

  • Hold the bar for a moment and drag it anywhere, on any monitor. Its place is remembered. Low on the screen, the results and menus open above it.
  • Right-click the bar → Put the bar back in the center (shown once it has been moved).

Customization

All options are in the ⋯ settings panel (in six languages) and in the mod's Settings tab in Windhawk (English and Portuguese).

| Block | Options | |---|---| | ① Mode | Original Siri (default), Floating, Window, Fullscreen | | ② Theme | Clear glass, Light, Dark, OLED, Siri (macOS 27 gradient), Custom | | Language | Automatic (Windows) or English, Português, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano | | ③ Appearance | Theme defaults button, glass transparency (each theme keeps its own; Light and OLED start solid), corner rounding, background blur (0 = no blur), blur behind right-click menus, text color (automatic: on clear glass, black over light backgrounds; or white or black), clear glass style (frosted, or experimental liquid for Floating and Original Siri, with its refraction strength and an optional live mode), glass effect on Light/Dark/OLED | | ④ Custom theme | Color, opacity, dark-to-light gradient, border width, color and opacity | | ⑤ Window and Fullscreen | Window size, search style (top bar or centered box), power button and its position, opening and closing animations (pop, fade, rise from/sink into the taskbar, CRT), animation speed, blur behind open folders | | ⑥ Floating and Original Siri | Bar size, results box width and rows for each category (Files and Clipboard as wide as the bar by default), circle animation (Siri wave, soft glow, none), circle zoom, bounce of the circle and of the results box, opening/closing duration, animation speed, power options when typing, floating power button, first row (recent, most used, off), Original Siri category shortcuts for Applications, Files, Actions and Clipboard (defaults Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2, Ctrl+3, Ctrl+4; any combination starting with Ctrl, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+F or Ctrl+F2), and whether they also work with the launcher closed (off by default) | | ⑦ Opening | Open with the Windows key and/or the Start button | | ⑧ Apps and icons | Icon size, columns, scrolling direction, jiggle, drag to the taskbar to pin, icon gallery folder | | ⑨ Files | On/off, search history, list or icons, indexer, maximum results | | ⑩ Clipboard | On/off, number of items kept, how long a copy stays |

Keyboard and mouse

| Key / action | What it does | |---|---| | Win / Start button | Open or close | | Type | Search (in Original Siri, typing right away searches Applications) | | Ctrl+1 / 2 / 3 / 4 | Original Siri: go to Applications / Files / Actions / Clipboard (configurable). With Also with the launcher closed on (off by default) they open the launcher from any program, and other programs no longer get those keys | | Tab / Shift+Tab | Original Siri: next/previous app tab, or move through the results in Files, Clipboard and Actions | | Arrows + Enter | Move through results / open | | Other Ctrl+digits | Launch the matching result (never an action such as Shut down) | | Esc | Closes menus, then clears the search, goes back to the categories and finally closes | | Right-click on the search bar | Cut, Copy, Paste, Select all, Delete all | | Long-press an app | Select it; then a simple click selects or deselects more apps (Window/Fullscreen: right-click → New folder with N items puts them in a folder; Original Siri: inside the app picker) |

Requirements

  • Windows 11 (x64)
  • Windhawk
  • Live blur needs Transparency effects turned on in Windows (Settings → Personalization → Colors). Without it, a blurred still image is used.
  • Optional: Everything for instant file search (run it normally, not as administrator)

Privacy and files

  • The mod never goes online.
  • Its own files (icons restored from a backup, the colors found for the gallery's images) are kept in the mod's storage folder, which Windhawk removes together with the mod. The gallery's images are only read from the folder you choose; backups are written only where you choose.
  • The clipboard history lives in memory only and is never written to disk.

Compatibility

  • Category shortcuts from any program (off by default): when Shortcuts → Also with the launcher closed is on, Ctrl+1 … Ctrl+4 are registered as system hotkeys, so other programs no longer get them (for example, the browser's Ctrl+1 for the first tab). Leave it off, or pick other combinations, if you need those keys elsewhere.
  • Fullscreen Start (fullscreen-start): don't enable both. Each one replaces the Start menu through the same hook without calling the original, so only one of them would get the Windows key.
  • Spotlight Launcher: it adds a separate search bar on Alt+Space and leaves the Start menu alone. This mod replaces the Start menu itself (Windows key and Start button) and adds app tabs, folders, files, clipboard history and actions. Both can be used together.

entry.title: Rounded Selection Rectangle 1.0
entry.content:
English

Gives the rectangle you draw to select files rounded corners and a gentle fade when you release the mouse. Works on the desktop, in File Explorer and in apps that use standard Windows list controls.

  • Adjust the corner roundness, border width and background opacity.
  • Choose background and border colors independently, or keep Windows default for either one.
  • Set the fade-out duration, or use 0 to turn it off. The mod respects the Windows animation setting.

In Background color and Border color, choose Custom color and enter a color such as #8B5CF6. Windows default ignores the custom value and follows the system color. Custom colors affect only the selection rectangle.

Compatible with Win32 UI Modernizer.

Other selection-rectangle mods, such as Desktop Marquee Fade and Classic Selection Rectangle Color, can overlap with this mod's fade or override its colors. Disable overlapping features if you use them together.

This mod depends on symbols published by Microsoft. If a Windows update has no published symbols, or changes the symbols the mod uses, the mod will stop working until compatible symbols or an updated mod are available.

Rounded selection in Home (WinUI)

File Explorer's Home page uses WinUI. To round its selection rectangle, install and enable Windows 11 File Explorer Styler in Windhawk. In that mod's settings, add an entry under Control styles and set Target to:

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Shapes.Rectangle#SelectionRectangle

Under Styles, add each of these four lines as a separate style:

Fill:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" Opacity="0.25" />
Stroke:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" />
RadiusX:=8
RadiusY:=8

Save the settings. This uses the Windows accent color, a 25% opacity fill and 8-unit corner radii. To change the roundness, adjust both RadiusX and RadiusY. These styles are configured separately from this mod's settings.

Português

Deixa o retângulo que você arrasta para selecionar arquivos com cantos arredondados e um desaparecimento suave ao soltar o mouse. Funciona na área de trabalho, no Explorador de Arquivos e em aplicativos com listas padrão do Windows.

  • Ajuste o arredondamento dos cantos, a espessura da borda e a opacidade do fundo.
  • Escolha as cores do fundo e da borda separadamente, ou mantenha o Padrão do Windows em cada uma.
  • Defina a duração do desaparecimento, ou use 0 para desativá-lo. O mod respeita a configuração de animações do Windows.

Em Cor do fundo e Cor da borda, escolha Cor personalizada e informe uma cor como #8B5CF6. Padrão do Windows ignora o valor personalizado e acompanha a cor do sistema. As cores personalizadas afetam somente o retângulo de seleção.

Compatível com o Win32 UI Modernizer.

Outros mods de retângulo de seleção, como Desktop Marquee Fade e Classic Selection Rectangle Color, podem sobrepor o fade ou as cores deste mod. Desative as funções equivalentes se usar esses mods juntos.

Este mod depende dos símbolos publicados pela Microsoft. Se uma atualização do Windows não tiver símbolos publicados, ou alterar os símbolos usados pelo mod, ele deixará de funcionar até que símbolos compatíveis ou uma atualização do mod estejam disponíveis.

Seleção arredondada na pasta Início (WinUI)

A pasta Início do Explorador de Arquivos usa WinUI. Para arredondar seu retângulo de seleção, instale e ative o Windows 11 File Explorer Styler no Windhawk. Nas configurações desse mod, adicione uma entrada em Control styles (estilos dos controles) e preencha Target (alvo) com:

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Shapes.Rectangle#SelectionRectangle

Em Styles (estilos), adicione cada uma destas quatro linhas como um estilo separado:

Fill:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" Opacity="0.25" />
Stroke:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" />
RadiusX:=8
RadiusY:=8

Salve as configurações. Isso usa a cor de destaque do Windows, fundo com 25% de opacidade e cantos de 8 unidades. Para mudar o arredondamento, ajuste RadiusX e RadiusY. Esses estilos são configurados separadamente das opções deste mod.

Español

Da esquinas redondeadas y un desvanecimiento suave al rectángulo que arrastras para seleccionar archivos. Funciona en el escritorio, en el Explorador de archivos y en aplicaciones con listas estándar de Windows.

  • Ajusta las esquinas, el grosor del borde y la opacidad del fondo.
  • Elige los colores de fondo y borde por separado, o conserva el Predeterminado de Windows para cada uno.
  • Ajusta la duración del desvanecimiento, o usa 0 para desactivarlo. El mod respeta la configuración de animaciones de Windows.

En Color de fondo y Color del borde, selecciona Color personalizado e introduce un color como #8B5CF6. Predeterminado de Windows ignora el valor personalizado y sigue el color del sistema. Los colores personalizados afectan sólo al rectángulo de selección.

Compatible con Win32 UI Modernizer.

Otros mods del rectángulo de selección, como Desktop Marquee Fade y Classic Selection Rectangle Color, pueden superponer el desvanecimiento o los colores. Desactiva las funciones equivalentes si usas esos mods juntos.

Este mod depende de los símbolos publicados por Microsoft. Si una actualización de Windows no tiene símbolos publicados, o cambia los símbolos que usa el mod, dejará de funcionar hasta que haya símbolos compatibles o una actualización del mod.

Selección redondeada en Inicio (WinUI)

La página Inicio del Explorador de archivos usa WinUI. Para redondear su rectángulo de selección, instala y activa Windows 11 File Explorer Styler en Windhawk. En los ajustes de ese mod, añade una entrada en Control styles (estilos de controles) e introduce lo siguiente en Target (destino):

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Shapes.Rectangle#SelectionRectangle

En Styles (estilos), añade cada una de estas cuatro líneas como un estilo separado:

Fill:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" Opacity="0.25" />
Stroke:=<SolidColorBrush Color="{ThemeResource SystemAccentColor}" />
RadiusX:=8
RadiusY:=8

Guarda los ajustes. Esto usa el color de énfasis de Windows, un fondo con un 25% de opacidad y esquinas de 8 unidades. Para cambiar el redondeado, ajusta RadiusX y RadiusY. Estos estilos se configuran por separado de las opciones de este mod.

entry.title: Crazy Time 0.7.0
entry.content:
Crazy Time

A minimalist scheduler for shutdown, sleep and hibernate, living in the notification area. Português abaixo.

This mod really shuts down, sleeps or hibernates your computer when a schedule fires. Save your work first. A warning notification appears before the action, and you can cancel or postpone an occurrence from the panel.

Windows 10 is untested. It was developed and tested on Windows 11 only. It is expected to work on Windows 10 (version 1809 or newer for the dark theme of the controls), but this has not been verified. Please report issues.

What it does

  • Schedule an action by duration (1 minute to 7 days), at a date and time, or repeating on chosen weekdays.
  • Keep several schedules at once: edit, pause, cancel one occurrence, postpone it by 10 minutes, or delete.
  • Countdown warnings at 30, 15, 10, 5 and 1 minute, with optional sound.
  • Schedules at the same instant are detected and refused.
  • Optional per-schedule "force apps to close" (shutdown only), off by default, with a data-loss warning.
  • Actions the computer cannot perform are explained instead of scheduled.
  • Portuguese and English; automatic, light or dark theme; high contrast.

How to use

  1. Enable the mod. A tray icon appears; click it to open the panel.
  2. Pick the action and how it is scheduled, then press Add schedule.
  3. Click the tray icon to open the panel again. Closing the panel keeps the countdown running; right-click the icon or use Options to exit. Exit stops scheduling until Windhawk restarts or the mod is toggled off and on again; Windhawk still lists the mod as enabled.
  4. Disabling the mod stops everything and removes the icon. Schedules are saved per user; occurrences that expired while the mod was off are not run.

Schedules are stored in Windhawk's mod storage, in a file named with your user SID. On first use, an existing legacy LocalAppData schedule file is copied there without overwriting an existing destination. The legacy file is kept as a backup. Removing the mod deletes Windhawk's managed storage; the legacy backup remains.
